scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev --prefix shared" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix shared && npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
